steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Cartridge paper: 120-300 gsm, textured surface, good for sketching and marker work.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Corrugated board: two liner layers with fluted medium - excellent crush resistance, lightweight, used for packaging.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Foam-core board: polystyrene foam sandwiched between card layers - very lightweight, rigid, easy to cut; used for architectural models.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Solid white board: high-quality bleached board, 200+ gsm - smooth surface for printing and packaging.

steps.title: Try it yourself

Justify the choice of foam-core board over corrugated board. | Compare the suitability of cartridge paper and layout paper for producing a final design presentation.

steps.title: Exam tips
